title: Case: Cancelled order is packed but has not left the merchant warehouse
context: The merchant has authorised cancellation while the packed item is still in its warehouse. Warehouse stop confirmation is required before calling dispatch cancelled.
initial_request: Please get the warehouse to stop DL-1358 before the next outbound sweep. The cancellation is authorised, but the physical dispatch stop is not confirmed.

events.body: Cancellation CAN-2685 is authorised for TG-3141 at 08:45 UTC today. DL-1358 is packed in outbound cage O7 and has no carrier handover scan. Refund processing is a separate task.
Please get the warehouse to stop DL-1358 before the next outbound sweep. The cancellation is authorised, but the physical dispatch stop is not confirmed.
Please get the warehouse to stop DL-1358 before the next outbound sweep. The cancellation is authorised, but the physical dispatch stop is not confirmed.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the warehouse to stop dispatch using the merchant's recorded cancellation authority.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Any team at Sedgemoor Goods that appears in the history
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the warehouse to stop dispatch using the merchant's recorded cancellation authority. (asking that team to act or to route it to the team that owns it)

must_not: Dispatch stop is not a refund approval, payment or completed customer communication.
Treats the repeated copy of the request as a second, separate request (for example by sending two requests to the same team)
expected.reference_message: Apply CAN-2685 to stop DL-1358 in cage O7 now. Please confirm physical removal from outbound dispatch and the resulting shipment status.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-040: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The escalation message arrives twice; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
